description.en: Turkish judge and historian with engagement in hadith.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: ʿAlī (Shalabī) b. Amr Allāh b. ʿAbd al-Qādir al-Humaidī al-Rūmī Sayf al-Dīn wa-ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn known as Qīnālī-zāda, al-ʿAlāʾī, and Ibn al-Ḥanālī

tr: Alî (Şelbî) b. Emrullâh b. Abdulkâdir el-Humaydi er-Rûmî Seyfüddîn ve Alâülddîn el-Ma'rûf bi-Kıynâlizâde ve el-Alâî ve İbn el-Hanâlî
